module: Flowgraph node 'Check Players Position' (repeat_instant category, file goToStartLine). Classifies the vehicle's position relative to the start line according to the 'distance' pin: > 0.35 = outLineForward (too far ahead), < 0 = outLineBackward (too far behind), otherwise inLine (well positioned). The impulse pin 'reset' resets the outputs to false.
notes: The output pin 'flow' is never written in work.
The 'velocity' pins and the retrieved vehicle are not used.
The two outputs outLineForward and outLineBackward have the same description ('Outflow when the vehicle is not in position').

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: On reset: everything false. Otherwise sets inLine/outLineForward/outLineBackward according to distance.
